sourceState: Dirty working-tree checkpoint; baseline uses the immediately preceding backend and matching types/register sources, not HEAD.
scope: Actual ARM32/Thumb GP register edits, verified rollback and software-trap primitives on native ARMv7 and AArch64 compat kernels, plus native AArch64 GP/trap regressions.

resources.toolchainInstallation: ARM32 crosscompiler added only to the existing owned cecompat-foreign container; host fetched SHA256-verified packages.
